description: AIDRES (Advancing industrial decarbonisation by assessing the future use of renewable energies in industrial processes) builds a spatially explicit database of future demand for renewable energy carriers, electricity, gases, liquid fuels and heat, for pathways of six energy-intensive industrial sectors in the European Union. The JRC Data Catalogue page lists the AIDRES datasets and documentation as a downloadable Excel file and an ArcGIS map service in the JRC Energy and Industry Geography Lab, both under CC BY 4.0 with no access limitations, contributed by Karolien Vermeiren, Leen Van Esch, Lorenz Hambsch and Wim Clymans; DataCite gives an issue date of 26 April 2023 and an update in March 2026. Coverage is EU industrial sites. Caveats: the six sectors, the pathway years and the spatial unit are not stated in the part of the page read. For simulation it gives where and how much renewable electricity, hydrogen and heat industry would need, to test grid and pipeline capacity for industrial decarbonisation. Related catalogue records include IndustryHeat-EU and the Hotmaps industrial sites with excess heat.
